detail: No new finding. The HEAD diff was read at the cause on the four hunks with the widest behaviour: the scoped graph delete, the shared ownership predicate and its two callers, the metrics append path, and the pre-bridge socket refusal. Each was correct in both directions it could have failed.

Carry-forward for synthesis: the win32 skip in isOwnedPrivateDir now also relaxes FileRouteReceiptStore.ownedFolder() because that method was rewritten onto the shared predicate. The old inline test required (mode & 0o077) === 0, which 0o40777 never satisfies, so the receipt store could not write on Windows at all. The new behaviour is a fix, and it doubles the call sites of an accepted P2 rather than creating a new one.

Evidence limit carried: no Windows run and no second-uid process were available this pass. G5-I9-P2-001 rests on Node's documented mode reporting plus the in-repo stub, and the foreign-owner branch of the shadow and metrics guards rests on the code and the suites run in earlier iterations.
